name: Er
overview: The name Er appears in Scripture primarily as the firstborn son of Judah, who was described as wicked and consequently slain by the LORD (Genesis 38:3, 6-7). Er's death is noted alongside his brother Onan's, both having died in the land of Canaan (Genesis 46:12; Numbers 26:19). Additionally, the name Er identifies an ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus, linking him to the Messiah's lineage (Luke 3:28). These references highlight Er's place within Judah's family line and the broader biblical narrative leading to Christ.
